title: Partition labels
statement: Split the string into as many parts as possible so that each letter appears in at most one part. Return the part sizes in order.
hints: A part containing letter c must extend at least to c's last occurrence.
Grow the current part's end to the max last-occurrence seen; cut when you reach it.

solution.explanation: Precompute each letter's last index. Scanning, the current part must reach at least max(last[c]) over its letters; when i reaches that bound, nothing inside appears later, so cut. Cutting as early as possible maximises the number of parts. It's merge intervals in disguise: each letter is the interval [first, last], and the parts are the merged groups.
